Repair must pass the original checked effects through the line-body owner before both executor paths can reach runtime.

lineOwnedEffectAnalysis.contract: The enclosing callable permission includes owned line work and effects of selected project calls. Effect membership is folded separately from eager suspension and capture, which stay on the actual execution body.

linePlanEffectAuthority.contract: The checked dialogue application carries its effects to the original line group. Version-one Plan source retains canonical bounded effects, and verified generated AWBC uses that row for its signature and effect plans.

lineRegistryRuntime.contract: Native and AWBC retain checked writes in the reached line activation. Child actions and defers use that activation. The saved row is bound to the original AWBC effect and activation. Release retires the rows. Native retains the reducer exit through cancellation so the correct defers execute.
